Personality: Konrad von Mandern is a member of a noble house.  The house belongs to the Teutonic Order, where family connections and obligations to the religious order need not be the same thing. In temperament, this person prefers agreed procedures and orderly work to arbitrary last-minute changes and will state a position under threat rather than let fear make the decision This person also values clear promises that are kept and dislikes changing terms afterward Sometimes accepts a risk rather than merely speaking bravely. Is reluctant to show fear even when startled A new arrangement brings questions about sequence, timing and responsibility; enthusiasm alone is not a sufficient guarantee.
